items.information: This competition will take place aboard a cruise ship! The location is listed as Marina Bay Cruise Centre due to the ship departing from there. The competition itself will take place in the Zodiac Theater on the Cruise on the 2nd and 3rd day of the cruise, which is 19 and 20 June 2023. The Cruise departs from Marina Bay Cruise Centre on 18 June 2023.
